name: School's Out TREK Camps
operator_name: School's Out, South Burlington School District
description_short: Week long themed day camps for South Burlington students entering 5th grade and up, based at Frederick H. Tuttle Middle School, 9am to 4pm. Each week centers on one interest, such as hiking, cooking, songwriting, martial arts or STEM, with many full day field trips.
refund_policy_summary: Withdrawing with less than two weeks notice means paying that week in full. The $50 deposit per child per week is non-refundable and non-transferable.
notes: 2026 registration closed and all programs filled. Grades: the camp page says students currently in 4th to 8th grade (2025 to 26); the TREK guide says entering 5th grade and up. $350 a week, $345 for a sibling, plus a $50 deposit per child per week; before and after care 8 to 9am and 4 to 5pm costs extra. A half day camp (noon to 4pm, Fridays 9 to 4) for students in Summer School or ESY costs $250. Several camps run each week; week 2 is four days.
